title:
Comment of Sarah E Templeton in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15410-000, P-15410-001
Submission Date: 11/1/2026

documents.name: 152034.txt
documents.text:
Sarah E Templeton, KENAI, AK.
I am writing to you to stop the permit process for Deepgreen Cook Inlet spv llc. The implications of the data center would be grossly underestimated and would be detrimental to the endangered Cook Inlet beluga whales, all the species of the Salmon population just to name a couple. 
As a member of the community I feel very strongly that not one individual in this community would support this! Please protect our fragile ecosystem.
Thank you
Sara Templeton
